name: Data.card_detIndex
summary: The count is a sum of column multiplicities, eventually constant; the bound follows from card_detIndex_add_bigCharExp.

steps.claim: First: |DetIndex j τ| = Σ_{h<k+j−1} k⁺(τ, h) + 𝗁′, and the sum up to |BigIndex j| is the same since the multiplicities vanish beyond k + j − 1 (eventually_constant_sum, sum_range_succ, grind). Second: by card_detIndex_add_bigCharExp and j ≤ m, the count is at most b₁ + b₂ + 𝗁 + m·𝗁.
steps.lean:
⟨by simp [← sum_range]; rw [eq_comm, eventually_constant_sum (N := D.posRank j + 1),
  sum_range_succ] <;> grind, by grind [card_detIndex_add_bigCharExp j τ, mul_le_mul_left j.2.2 D.h]⟩
